incident.summary: Publish retry loop keyed dedup on the endpoint-returned slug; the endpoint appends -2/-3 on slug collisions, so 6 of 8 articles were re-inserted on each retry, creating duplicate rows. An initial batch POST also returned HTTP 546 WORKER_RESOURCE_LIMIT (8 base64 images in one request) after partial inserts.
incident.action_required: Manually delete duplicate rows for the duplicated_slugs in Supabase project jcezmolckegxlvizvmtj (public.articles). Agent cannot delete (insert-only scope).
incident.remediation: Send at most 1-2 base64 images per request; dedup retries by the SENT slug and stop retrying any slug once ANY inserted status is returned (even with a -N suffix).
